But the 34 tracks on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album represent only a small fraction of the music featured in the game itself.
For the full tracklist and much more, including details on the Original Score composed by Justice coming December 11

plans.topic: How Hans Zimmer and RÜFÜS DU SOL reimagined Innerbloom XI as a nine-minute orchestral arrangement for the original song's eleventh anniversary.
plans.core_claim: Hans Zimmer reimagined RÜFÜS DU SOL's Innerbloom as a nine-minute orchestral arrangement for its eleventh anniversary, retaining the original vocals.
plans.title: Hans Zimmer Reimagines RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Innerbloom'
plans.hook: What changes when an electronic song meets an orchestra?
plans.description: A sourced arrangement breakdown of Innerbloom XI: Variety reports the RÜFÜS DU SOL and Hans Zimmer collaboration, while DJ Mag describes its nine-minute orchestral treatment and retained original vocals. The Violin Prince payoff uses a newly composed, unrelated motif to demonstrate how orchestral layers change texture without borrowing the source melody or recording.
plans.cover_payoff: Compose a new violin phrase that begins as a restrained repeating pulse, then gains original string counterlines and percussion-like accents. Do not quote, imitate or sample Innerbloom, its vocal or its melody.
plans.narration_script: Can an electronic classic become orchestral? Variety says Zimmer joins RÜFÜS DU SOL to reimagine Innerbloom. DJ Mag describes a nine-minute orchestral arrangement retaining the original vocals. The release marks exactly the song's eleventh anniversary.

narration_evidence.quote: Australia’s RÜFÜS DU SOL have teamed with legendary composer Hans Zimmer for a reimagining of their classic track, “Innerbloom”.
The nine-minute orchestral arrangement transforms the Australian trio’s emotive electronic classic into a cinematic composition, while retaining the original vocals from Tyrone Lindqvist.
The reimagined version, “Innerbloom XI”, comes out exactly on the 11th anniversary of the original song’s release, which featured on their second studio album, Bloom.

plans.narration_script: Can a song introduce a film's world? Stereogum says Tems executive-produces its soundtrack and released the lead single. StupidDope confirms African Love Story arrived through RCA November twentieth. Burna Boy is its executive music consultant.

narration_evidence.quote: It'll also have a soundtrack executive produced by the Nigerian star Tems, and her first single is out today.
Tems has released African Love Story, the lead single from Children of Blood and Bone (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack), out now on November 20, 2026, via RCA Records.
Tems wrote and performs the song, and she also serves as the soundtrack executive music producer and curator, with Burna Boy as executive music consultant.
